changelog.description: Baseline release: Named application Ductfit Pro and set initial baseline version 1.00.000
Added ASHRAE Fitting Code Details button (Table 5 guide modal dialog)
Integrated official ASHRAE Handbook Chapter 21 Colebrook equation for friction factor calculation
Fixed server connectivity and verified daemon port 5052 stability
Added KaTeX mathematical textbook formatting for calculation formulas
Expanded catalog with official ASHRAE duct fitting database categories and tables
Product branding finalized to 'Ductfit Pro'
Reorganized UI into unified 3-part engineering calculation panel
Cleaned up redundant interface elements and enhanced visual layout
Moved Velocity (V) into input side with bi-directional continuity solving (Q = A * V)
Converted inputs and outputs to authentic ASHRAE vertical column table layout
Resilience checks and connection watchdog on port 5052
Configured Equal Friction Method and multi-way bi-directional continuity solver
Added reactive click handling and instant page synchronization for catalog items
Added comprehensive duct fittings catalog dataset
Added transitions and elbow fittings to catalog
Added tees, wyes, and junction fittings to catalog
Added diffusers, dampers, and terminal fittings
Deep audit of McQuay Duct Sizer algorithm and thermodynamic properties
Organized catalog hierarchy into official Supply, Common, and Exhaust/Return groups
Auto Duct Sizer: Flow rate, target head loss, and automatic cross-dimension solver
Removed redundant fitting loss elements from Auto Duct Sizer workflow
Added McQuay-parity Air Condition panel (STP, Comfort Return, Supply, Warm, Cold)
Harmonized thermodynamic density (ρ) and viscosity (μ) with ASHRAE Fundamentals
Implemented dual-mode sizing for both Equal Friction and Velocity Limitation methods
Added Step-by-Step Engineering Calculation Breakdown panel with symbolic and numeric substitutions
Scoped Air Condition panel strictly to Auto Duct Sizer mode (hidden in Fitting Loss Analysis)
Repositioned Auto Duct Sizer button to top navigation bar and cleaned catalog tree
Configured initial opening state of Auto Duct Sizer to completely blank columns with placeholders
Replaced hardcoded 0.80 Pa/m with dynamic project-specific design targets (1.20 Pa/m, 0.60 Pa/m, V constraint, IP units)
Implemented automated incremental versioning system with version.json, /api/version, and UI badge binding
Removed redundant Rect and Round pills from top navigation bar
Unified Auto Duct Sizer with full McQuay parity: single unified cross-section interface, bi-directional multi-way solving, Reset/Clear button, and 2017 ASHRAE Ch. 21 core citation
Step-by-step engineering breakdown enabled for fitting loss analysis and all equations matched to 2021 ASHRAE Handbook Ch. 21 PDF
Updated UI badges, citations, and metadata to authoritative ASHRAE 2021 Edition (Ch. 21)
Added Project Management: Create project with code/name/client/contractor/subcontractor, add calculated fittings, and interactive Project Summary Schedule table (ASHRAE Database Model)

Added multi-page Fitduct pro PDF report generation matching AFA.pdf with master schedule cover page, project metadata, and dedicated per-fitting CAD blueprint + step-by-step engineering calculation breakdown
Added dedicated option to download current step-by-step engineering calculation in PDF format from calculation breakdown panel and action row
Added high-precision bi-directional SI <-> IP dynamic unit conversion preserving all user-entered inputs and controls
Refined version format to v1.XXX standard (removed extra zeroes, e.g. v1.035 style)
Removed download button from calculation breakdown header, kept primary Download PDF button in calculation action row
Added dedicated Full Screen View and shortcut keys (C, Shift+F, F context-aware, Esc, +/- zoom) for Step-by-Step Engineering Calculation Breakdown
Restored and enhanced ASHRAE Absolute Roughness Material Selector (e / ei) with interactive label link, material badge, quick picker button, and keyboard navigation modal
Roughness field defaults to blank/nil on app startup, reload, and reset; stays persistent once entered by user
Cleaned absolute roughness UX: clickable link opens picker, removed redundant right-box button and badge, removed placeholders and sample projects
Purged all sample projects, sample schedules, and prefilled project metadata
Highlighted pressure loss details in calculation output table
Enforced strict ASHRAE Database standard air density 1.204 SI / 0.075 IP for Fitting Loss Analysis
Removed velocity target badge from Actual Head Loss cell in Auto Duct Sizer
Moved Velocity from Input table to Output table in Fitting Loss Analysis as per ASHRAE database standard
Removed telephone and fax numbers from PDF report header on all pages
Synchronized 234 official ASHRAE database fittings and junction output sections
Full name in hoods restored without truncation in catalog and PDF; added draggable and one-click enlargement for complete Fitduct Pro Fitting Catalog area
Removed enlarge button from catalog header and toolbar per user request while retaining smooth draggable border resizer

changelog.description: Fix CF11-1 straight flat oval duct aerodynamic calculations matching official ASHRAE database 100%
Precision matching for CD11-1, CD11-2, CR6-4, CD3-15, CD3-3/4 and full Ductfit Pro rebrand
Fix CD6-2 diameter overwrite, CD9-1 / SD2-6 / SD2-7 trailing dot table parsing, SD2-2 and SD2-7 input visibility
Precision parity for SD5-11, SD5-15, SD5-16, SD5-23 matching official ASHRAE Duct Fitting Database

Separated Auto Duct Sizer and Fitting Loss Analysis workflows, distinct schedules, dedicated Duct Sizing PDF report without CAD drawings, professional tabular fonts for numbers, replaced 2021 handbook mentions with ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch 21, and updated PDF report headers
